description: An eight to one switch that passes one of its eight inputs to a single output, stepped forwards, backwards or at random

params.text: Sends that input to the output when clicked, whatever the step triggers were about to do
Sets how many of the eight steps are in use, 1 to 8; the switch cycles or stops at the last one
Keeps a random pick from landing on the step already selected
Moves the selection back one step, wrapping from step 1 round to the highest step in use
Moves the selection on one step, wrapping from the highest step in use back to step 1
Picks a step at random from those in use
Returns the switch to step 1 or to no step at all, according to the reset style button, and clears the count one shot mode keeps
Chooses what a reset does: return to step 1, or select no step until the next step trigger arrives, with the output at 0V until then
Stops the switch once it has taken as many steps as the Steps knob allows, until a reset arrives; steps in any direction are counted

inputs.text: One of the eight signals the switch chooses from; while it is the selected step its channel count sets the channel count of the output
Sets how many steps are in use, the voltage read as the step number, rounded and held between 1 and 8; a cable here takes the Steps knob out of use
A trigger here moves the selection back one step
A trigger here moves the selection on one step
A trigger here picks a step at random from those in use
A trigger here resets the switch, as the reset button does

outputs.text: Carries whatever the selected input carries, at that input's channel count; it falls to 0V when no step is selected or the selected input has no cable

notes: A Manus expander placed immediately to the left selects any of the eight steps directly from its own trigger inputs.
menu: Add Manus expander — puts a Manus expander immediately to the left of this module and connects it; the entry reads "Manus expander already connected" when one is already there

inputs.8:
1 to 8V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.9: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.10: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.11: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
